# A v1 state snapshot

Files as they looked before the development spec: no `schema_version`, and the pre-M5.3 LoRA genome where the genome of
Appendix C now goes. `feedback/experiences.jsonl` ends mid-line because a snapshot of a killed process does.

Used by `tests/test_legacy_state.py` (Appendix I): the system has to come up on these, tick, and keep both the champion and the
benchmark history.
